given: a stock record whose batch is populated
then: the batch field shows that record's batch value
architectural_notes: E2E: value-binding assertion flowing from the stock_records.batch_number column through app/repositories -> app/services -> the boundary JSON -> the SPA stock-view component. Owner module is the SPA stock-view component bound to the boundary's batch_number field. Realizes the design by verifying the read path preserves and displays the persisted batch value unchanged; no transformation or business logic lives in the boundary or the component.

independence.rationale: AC1 and AC2 only concern the presence of the labelled batch field and the absence of the combined code; this adds the distinct outcome that the batch field is bound to and displays the record's actual batch value. The field could render empty or with a wrong value while still being present (AC1 green, AC3 red).
